 APPSC ASSISTANT PROFESSOR ADMIT CARD 2026 OUT 
 APPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 Out, Download Phase 3 Interview Hall Ticket
 APPSC has released the Assistant Professor Phase III admit card for Political Science, Economics, Geography and Hindi. Candidates can download the interview hall ticket from November 4 to November 11, 2026, at 7 PM. Khushi Priya 5 Nov, 2026 Share

 The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released the APPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 for the Phase III Viva-Voce/Interview under the Department of Education, Government of Arunachal Pradesh. The admit card is available for candidates from Political Science, Economics, Geography and Hindi.
 Candidates can also check the CMHO Jashpur Final Merit List 2026 for selection updates.  
 The download facility started on November 4, 2026, at 7 PM and will remain open until November 11, 2026, at 7 PM. Candidates can access their interview admit cards through the official APPSC portal using their registered One Time Registration details.   
 The Phase III selection process will be conducted through a Viva-Voce/Interview carrying 100 marks. Candidates need to secure at least 50 marks, while the minimum qualifying marks for PwBD candidates are 47.5 marks. Candidates will also have to give a 10-minute classroom teaching demonstration on a topic of their choice from the concerned subject.   
 Candidates can also check the APPSC Assistant Professor Phase 3 Result 2026 for the latest result updates.

 APPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 Direct Link
 Candidates can download the APPSC Assistant Professor Phase III Admit Card 2026 through the official APPSC candidate login portal. The admit card download window is open from November 4, 2026, at 7 PM to November 11, 2026, at 7 PM. Candidates should use their registered login details to access and download the interview hall ticket.
 APPSC Assistant Professor 2026 Admit Card Direct Link 
 Candidates can also check the UPESSC PRT Assistant Teacher Application 2026 for registration details.  
 How to Download APPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026?
 Candidates can follow the steps below to access their Phase III Viva-Voce/Interview admit card:
 Visit the official APPSC website at appsc.gov.in.
 Open the Candidate Login or Admit Card section.
 Enter the registered mobile number or email address, as applicable.
 Enter the One Time Registration password.
 Complete the security captcha.
 Click on the Login option.
 Find the Assistant Professor Examination 2026 Phase III admit-card entry.
 Open the available Viva-Voce/Interview admit card.
 Check the subject, interview schedule, venue and other instructions.
 Download and print the admit card for the interview.
 Candidates can also check the RRB NTPC Graduate Application Window 2026 for the latest application updates.  
 Details to Check on APPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026
 After downloading the admit card, candidates should carefully verify the information provided on it. Key details to check include:
 Candidate Name
 Examination or Recruitment Name
 Subject
 Interview Date
 Reporting Time
 Interview Venue
 Identity Proof Instructions
 Original Document Requirements
 Other instructions issued by APPSC
 If any important information is incorrect or unclear, candidates should contact APPSC through its official channels before appearing for the interview.
 Candidates can also check the Punjab & Sind Bank LBO Phase 3 Result 2026 for the result and selection details.
